summary: With the goblins' backs turned, Carl climbs the now-driverless murder-dozer, throws one goblin into its spinning blade, beats the Goblin Engineer with his own pot helmet, then sprints back to the guild hall door with twelve seconds before the abandoned machine's boiler explodes.
emotional_beat: Carl's first real kills -- adrenaline curdling into nausea, then relief.
skip_policy: Physical action with clear visual stakes, building to a signature set-piece explosion.
